snippet.title: Time Gal (Time Gal & Ninja Hayate) PSX
snippet.description:
Running on Beetle PSX HW (Mednafen)

One iconic game from LaserDisk era
the game preserves the arcade logic: 
insert coin/credits/points pool and etc


on PSX/Saturn release the game came alongside 
 Ninja Hayate, his "brother" game


#Taito #ToeiCompany #TimeGal

#fmv #adventure #laserdisk
